assertions.title: Retry button shown on failed emails

steps.action: Sign in and open /email-delivery with default 7d range
steps.expected: A failed/bounced row and a non-failed row are both available for comparison
steps.observed: Only one sent row was present in the default dataset.

steps.expected: Failed/bounced rows appear with retry action
steps.observed: Both filtered states showed the empty-state message with zero rows.

steps.action: Use the documented forced error trigger /email-delivery?messageId=__force_error__
steps.expected: Could not be used for visibility comparison because it is an error-state fixture, not a normal delivery-log row
steps.observed: An error alert rendered with a standalone Retry button outside the table context.

evidence.consoleErrors: 500 and 418 resource errors were present during forced-error validation; no deterministic failed/bounced table row was available on the authenticated surface.
evidence.network: GET /api/ops/email-delivery?...status=failed and ...status=bounced executed, both resulting in empty-state UI with no rows to inspect.

assertions.issues: Blocked by unavailable deterministic failed/bounced delivery-log data on the authenticated surface; could not compare retry visibility on failed/bounced vs non-failed rows.

assertions.title: Retry confirmation dialog

steps.action: Open the documented forced-error trigger with messageId=__force_error__ and inspect the visible Retry button
steps.expected: Clicking Retry opens a confirmation dialog with recipient, subject, Confirm, and Cancel controls
steps.observed: Clicking Retry left the page in the same error-alert state; DOM inspection showed no role=dialog and no confirm/cancel controls.

evidence.consoleErrors: Hydration mismatch warnings plus repeated 418 errors were present in the forced-error fixture.
evidence.network: No POST retry request was issued when clicking the standalone Retry button in the forced-error state.

assertions.issues: Blocked because the only visible Retry control came from the forced error fixture and did not open a confirmation dialog; no failed/bounced row with table retry action was available.

assertions.title: Retry API endpoint

steps.action: Attempt to reach a retry flow from available authenticated delivery-log data
steps.observed: No confirmable retry flow was reachable because no failed/bounced row existed and the forced-error Retry button did not submit a POST.

evidence.consoleErrors: Forced-error route generated visible client console errors (418 responses) but no retry submission.
evidence.network: Tracked network requests only showed GET /api/ops/email-delivery and summary queries; no POST /api/ops/email-delivery/retry was observed.

assertions.issues: Blocked by absence of a deterministic retryable delivery-log row and lack of a working confirm flow from the forced-error fixture.

assertions.title: Retry success feedback

steps.action: Look for a successful retry path from a retryable delivery-log row
steps.expected: Success toast appears and delivery log refetches
steps.observed: Could not exercise a successful retry because no retryable row was available and no POST retry request could be triggered.

evidence.consoleErrors: No success-toast scenario reachable; available retry control was tied to an error fixture.
evidence.network: No POST /api/ops/email-delivery/retry or follow-up refetch attributable to a successful retry was observed.

assertions.issues: Blocked by unavailable deterministic success path for retry/resend behavior on the authenticated surface.

assertions.title: Retry error feedback

steps.expected: A retry action can be triggered and results in an error toast while the row remains failed
steps.observed: The page loaded directly into an error alert ('Unable to load email delivery attempts … Retry'); no row-level retry submission or toast event was available.

evidence.consoleErrors: Forced-error route produced 418 network failures and existing hydration mismatch warnings.
evidence.network: Only GET /api/ops/email-delivery?messageId=__force_error__... requests were observed; no POST retry call or toast-generating mutation occurred.

assertions.issues: Blocked because the available error fixture validates delivery-log load failure, not retry mutation failure; no row-level retry request could be triggered to observe error-toast behavior.

frictions.description: The authenticated surface had only a single sent row in the 7d dataset, so the assigned assertions could not be exercised against real failed/bounced rows.
The documented forced-error trigger exposed a standalone Retry button inside an error alert rather than a row-level retry flow, preventing confirmation-dialog and mutation testing.
